description: Native QA glossary SSOT for batch translation pipelines (de Sie-Form + ko honorific; ko/de 非本语言文字与 zh-TW 简体字形纯净门禁由 verify-i18n.mjs 强制执行).

rules: Use formal Sie/Ihr/Ihnen consistently; never du/dein unless quoting code or brand slogans.
Preserve ICU placeholders exactly ({count}, {name}, plural/select blocks).
Keep product brands untranslated: Myrm, MyrmAgent, MCP, OpenAI, GitHub, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Webhook.
Prefer established UI terms: Einstellungen, Fähigkeiten, Agent, Modell, Kanal, Speicher.
Button labels: short imperative (Speichern, Abbrechen, Löschen, Bestätigen).
Never mix Han characters or Japanese kana into German UI copy; only language-name labels (中文/日本語) and the cross-language term 합니다体 are exempt (enforced by verify-i18n).
Default to polite honorific (합니다/해요체); avoid 반말 in product UI.
Preserve ICU placeholders exactly.
Keep brands in Latin script: Myrm, MCP, OpenAI, GitHub, Webhook.
Use consistent product terms: 설정, 스킬, 에이전트, 모델, 채널, 메모리.
Never mix Han characters or Japanese kana into Korean UI copy; write native Hangul (설정 not 设置); only language-name labels (中文/日本語) are exempt (enforced by verify-i18n).
Use polite です/ます style consistently in product UI; plain form only for compact button labels.
Preserve ICU placeholders exactly.
Keep brands in Latin script: Myrm, MCP, OpenAI, GitHub, Webhook, OAuth, API, URL.
Use natural Japanese word order (verb last); never port Chinese word order literally.
Distinguish 新規 (new item) from 最新 (latest); never write 新規規 / 最新規.
可用 is 利用可能; never 利用可能性 for the adjective 利用可能.
Invalid state label is 無効 (disabled) — never 未有効.
Forbidden patterns must be minimal unique substrings that never occur in legit Japanese (e.g. 聚合, なし效, 検出まで); avoid generic kanji or kana like 管理ど that also appear in valid words (管理どのように, 管理どれ).
Chinese word-order compounds are rejected (forbidden list): 検索概念/選択権限/選択審査/選択推論/入力名前/入力検収/入力実行 must use natural Japanese (概念を検索, 権限タイプを選択, 名前を入力, コマンドを入力); 首個 must be 最初の.

Chinese-syntax prefixes + loanwords are rejected (forbidden list): 終ログイン must be ログアウト, 首ページ must be ホーム, 中ログイン must be ログイン中, 待ログイン must be ログイン待ち, 使用 Google/GitHub ログイン must be Google/GitHub でログイン, 戻るログイン must be ログインに戻る, 終サンドボックス must be サンドボックスを終了, 終状態 must be 終了状態, 最ビジーツール must be 最も使用されるツール, 首字レイテンシ must be 初回応答時間; 待確認事項/キュー待ち中 are legit (待ち = waiting).

Machine-translation fused words are rejected (forbidden list): サービス器 must be サーバー, ない明 must be 不明, 有エラー must be エラーあり, 読み取り取 must be 読み取り, 清空 must be クリア, 推送 must be 配信/プッシュ, 打包 must be パッケージ, 朗読み must be 読み上げ, コンテキスト包 must be コンテキストバンドル, 登録中心 must be レジストリ, セキュリティ中心 must be セキュリティセンター, 上回 (last) must be 前回; 個子タスク must be 個の子タスク.

Verb + space + noun word order is rejected (forbidden list): 選択/削除/編集/設定/追加 MCP must be MCP を選択/削除/編集/設定/追加, 作成/入力/保存 APIキー must be APIキーを作成/入力/保存, 起動 SearXNG/Shadow must be SearXNG/Shadow を起動, 追加 Agent/Webhook must be Agent/Webhook を追加, 作成/削除カンバン must be カンバンを作成/削除, エクスポート CSV/JSON must be CSV/JSON をエクスポート, インポート JSON/GitHub URL/MCP must be JSON/GitHub URL/MCP をインポート, クリア OAuth must be OAuth をクリア, 承認 + Shadow must be Shadow を承認.
Chinese-style residue phrases are rejected (forbidden list): 更変更 must be 変更, 上一回/下一回 must be 前回/次回, 次失敗/回失敗 must be 失敗, 確認元 must be 元に戻す, 上一ペ/下一ペ must be 前へ/次へ, 設定更 must be 設定変更.

Confirm/open/close verb + noun button labels must use object-first order (削除を確認 not 確認削除, 設定を開く not 開く設定, パネルを閉じる not 閉じるパネル, 会話を選択 not 選択ひとつ対話); action verbs glued directly onto nouns are rejected (forbidden list).
Chinese-only nouns pasted into Japanese are rejected (forbidden list): 小伙伴 must be コンパニオン, 演示文稿 must be プレゼンテーション, 選択要接続 must be 接続するエージェントを選択, ないアクティブ must be アクティブな会話がありません.
Prefer native terms: リージョン (region), ステップ (step), 詳細 (details), 異常 (abnormal), 診断 (diagnostics), ガバナンス (governance), トレース (trace), ライフサイクル (lifecycle), スケジュール (schedule).

Simplified-only glyphs (relative to Japanese new forms) are rejected (enforced by verify-i18n; full list lives in scripts/ja-simplified-glyphs.txt, generated from opencc cn→jp over the zh corpus, exempting JP-legal same-form/new-form glyphs 体/与/云/个/台/准/于/占/里/游/干/伙/携/进/万/发/当/回); only language-name labels and the cross-language term 합니다体 are exempt.

rules: Write traditional Chinese (繁體) consistently; never port simplified Chinese glyphs directly.
Preserve ICU placeholders exactly.
Keep brands in Latin script: Myrm, MCP, OpenAI, GitHub, Webhook, OAuth, API, URL.

Simplified-only glyphs are rejected (enforced by verify-i18n; full list lives in scripts/zh-simplified-glyphs.txt, generated from opencc cn→tw over the zh corpus, exempting TW-legal two-form glyphs 台/准/于/伙/占/里/游/干); only language-name labels and the cross-language term 합니다体 are exempt.
Use established Traditional terms: 設定 not 设置, 儲存 not 保存, 刪除 not 删除, 複製 not 复制.

Word-level residue of exempted two-form glyphs is rejected (forbidden list): 标准/准备/准确/准时/基准/云端/由于/用于/基于/低于/便于/小于/于此/属于/对于/位于/干净/干活/游戏/里面/这里/那里/哪里/关于/终于/家伙/舞台/屏幕/信息/窗口/兼容/搜索/界面 must use their Traditional forms 標準/準備/準確/準時/基準/雲端/由於/用於/基於/低於/便於/小於/於此/屬於/對於/位於/乾淨/幹活/遊戲/裡面/這裡/那裡/哪裡/關於/終於/傢伙/舞臺/螢幕/資訊/視窗/相容/搜尋/介面.
Cross-strait word residue is rejected (forbidden list): 支持→支援, 保存→儲存, 刷新→重新整理, 文件夾→資料夾, 拖拽→拖曳, 退出登入→登出, 全屏→全螢幕, 插件→外掛.
